pf10b_platform_constraint.summary: Queries invoking metrics.*(period: 1h, window: today) WITHOUT at least one companion metrics.*(period: 1d, window: 30d) call in the same query fail in gus-sdl with HTTP 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT ('no risk analytics metric data available for the time range'). Pairing (period: 1h, window: today) with any (period: 1d, window: 30d) metric lookup resolves the Capacitor Placer fileset and succeeds across 38/38 metrics.

malachite_source_evidence.mechanism: ReadUebaPlacerFilePaths checks UebaAnalyticDimensionalExports across the OR-union of all uebaMetadatas in the QueryRequest. When only (1h, today) (TimeWindowSize = 3600) is requested without a (1d, 30d) (TimeWindowSize = 86400) metadata entry, validPathExists evaluates to false on tenants where dimensional export metadata is indexed under 86400s windows, returning InvalidArgumentError('no risk analytics metric data available for the time range').

pf10b_platform_constraint.design_implication: 1) build_pf10_hourly_today_probes() in tests/live/live_compile_harness.py must include a companion (period: 1d, window: 30d) outcome (e.g., $d30_periods). 2) WS1-13 intra-day ('today so far') templates must ALWAYS pair (period: 1h, window: today) earlier-today context with (period: 1d, window: 30d) 30-day baselines — never emit standalone (1h, today)-only queries.

case_8a_user_login_zscore.query:
// §8a Live Baseline Reproduction: charles.hardy, frank.kolzig, maya.goodman on USER_LOGIN (2026-10-27)
stage stage1_extract {
    metadata.event_type = "USER_LOGIN"
    target.user.userid = /^(charles\.hardy|frank\.kolzig|maya\.goodman)$/ nocase
    target.user.userid = $entity
    $entity != ""

  match:
    $entity by 1d

  outcome:
    $observed_val = count(metadata.id)
    $hist_avg = max(metrics.auth_attempts_total(
        period: 1d, window: 30d, metric: event_count_sum, agg: avg,
        target.user.userid: target.user.userid
    ))
    $hist_stddev = max(metrics.auth_attempts_total(
        period: 1d, window: 30d, metric: event_count_sum, agg: stddev,
        target.user.userid: target.user.userid
    ))
    $hist_sum = max(metrics.auth_attempts_total(
        period: 1d, window: 30d, metric: event_count_sum, agg: sum,
        target.user.userid: target.user.userid
    ))
    $hist_periods = max(metrics.auth_attempts_total(
        period: 1d, window: 30d, metric: event_count_sum, agg: num_metric_periods,
        target.user.userid: target.user.userid
    ))
    $first_seen_ts = max(metrics.auth_attempts_total(
        period: 1d, window: 30d, metric: first_seen, agg: min,
        target.user.userid: target.user.userid
    ))
}

$entity = $stage1_extract.entity

match:
  $entity

outcome:
  $observed = sum($stage1_extract.observed_val)
  $historical_avg = max($stage1_extract.hist_avg)
  $historical_stddev = max($stage1_extract.hist_stddev)
  $historical_sum = max($stage1_extract.hist_sum)
  $baseline_days = max($stage1_extract.hist_periods)
  $first_seen = max($stage1_extract.first_seen_ts)
  $safe_sd = if($historical_stddev > 0, $historical_stddev, 1.0)
  $z_score = ($observed - $historical_avg) / $safe_sd

order:
  $z_score desc

case_8b_site_dc_cusum_maturity.query:
// §8b Live Baseline Reproduction: SITE-DC$ maturity failure on 14d longitudinal_cusum_2stage (2026-10-14 -> 2026-10-28)
stage stage1_extract {
    metadata.event_type = "USER_LOGIN"
    target.user.userid = $entity
    $entity != ""

  match:
    $entity by 1d

  outcome:
    $observed_val = count(metadata.id)
    $historical_avg = max(metrics.auth_attempts_total(
        period: 1d, window: 30d, metric: event_count_sum, agg: avg,
        target.user.userid: target.user.userid
    ))
    $historical_stddev = max(metrics.auth_attempts_total(
        period: 1d, window: 30d, metric: event_count_sum, agg: stddev,
        target.user.userid: target.user.userid
    ))
    $historical_active_days = max(metrics.auth_attempts_total(
        period: 1d, window: 30d, metric: event_count_sum, agg: num_metric_periods,
        target.user.userid: target.user.userid
    ))
    $daily_z = ($observed_val - $historical_avg) / if($historical_stddev > 0, $historical_stddev, 1.0)
    $deviation = $daily_z - 0.5
    $daily_excess = if($deviation > 0.0, $deviation, 0.0)
}

$entity = $stage1_extract.entity

match:
  $entity

outcome:
  $observed_val = max($stage1_extract.observed_val)
  $total_observed = sum($stage1_extract.observed_val)
  $baseline_mean = max($stage1_extract.historical_avg)
  $baseline_stddev = max($stage1_extract.historical_stddev)
  $active_days = max($stage1_extract.historical_active_days)
  $daily_z = max($stage1_extract.daily_z)
  $slack_excess = sum($stage1_extract.daily_excess)
  $cusum_drift_score = $slack_excess
  $drift_days = sum(if($stage1_extract.daily_excess > 0.0, 1, 0))

condition:
  $cusum_drift_score > 0.0 and $drift_days >= 2

order:
  $cusum_drift_score desc

case_8c_multi_sector_fusion_masking.query:
// §8c Live Baseline Reproduction: Single-outlier inner-join masking in multi_sector_fusion_4stage (2026-10-27)
stage sector_a {
    metadata.event_type = "USER_LOGIN"
    target.user.userid = $entity
    $entity != ""

  match:
    $entity by 1d

  outcome:
    $a_obs = count(metadata.id)
    $a_avg = max(metrics.auth_attempts_total(
        period: 1d, window: 30d, metric: event_count_sum, agg: avg,
        target.user.userid: target.user.userid
    ))
    $a_std = max(metrics.auth_attempts_total(
        period: 1d, window: 30d, metric: event_count_sum, agg: stddev,
        target.user.userid: target.user.userid
    ))
    $a_days = max(metrics.auth_attempts_total(
        period: 1d, window: 30d, metric: event_count_sum, agg: num_metric_periods,
        target.user.userid: target.user.userid
    ))
    $z_a_raw = ($a_obs - $a_avg) / if($a_std > 0, $a_std, 1.0)
    $z_a_pos = if($z_a_raw > 0, $z_a_raw, 0.0)
    $z_a = if($a_days >= 7, $z_a_pos, 0.0)
}

stage sector_b {
    metadata.event_type = "USER_LOGIN"
    not security_result.action = "ALLOW"
    target.user.userid = $entity
    $entity != ""

  match:
    $entity by 1d

  outcome:
    $b_obs = count(metadata.id)
    $b_avg = max(metrics.auth_attempts_fail(
        period: 1d, window: 30d, metric: event_count_sum, agg: avg,
        target.user.userid: target.user.userid
    ))
    $b_std = max(metrics.auth_attempts_fail(
        period: 1d, window: 30d, metric: event_count_sum, agg: stddev,
        target.user.userid: target.user.userid
    ))
    $b_days = max(metrics.auth_attempts_fail(
        period: 1d, window: 30d, metric: event_count_sum, agg: num_metric_periods,
        target.user.userid: target.user.userid
    ))
    $z_b_raw = ($b_obs - $b_avg) / if($b_std > 0, $b_std, 1.0)
    $z_b_pos = if($z_b_raw > 0, $z_b_raw, 0.0)
    $z_b = if($b_days >= 7, $z_b_pos, 0.0)
}

stage fleet_sector_norm {
    $ws = $sector_a.window_start
    $ws = $sector_b.window_start
    $e = $sector_a.entity
    $e = $sector_b.entity

  match:
    $ws

  outcome:
    $fleet_z_a_avg = avg($sector_a.z_a)
    $fleet_z_b_avg = avg($sector_b.z_b)
}

$entity = $sector_a.entity
$entity = $sector_b.entity
$ws = $sector_a.window_start
$ws = $sector_b.window_start
$ws = $fleet_sector_norm.ws

match:
  $entity, $ws by 1d

outcome:
  $a_observed = max($sector_a.a_obs)
  $b_observed = max($sector_b.b_obs)
  $a_active_days = max($sector_a.a_days)
  $b_active_days = max($sector_b.b_days)
  $z_a = max($sector_a.z_a)
  $z_b = max($sector_b.z_b)
  $fleet_a_mu = max($fleet_sector_norm.fleet_z_a_avg)
  $fleet_b_mu = max($fleet_sector_norm.fleet_z_b_avg)
  $dz_a_raw = $z_a - $fleet_a_mu
  $dz_b_raw = $z_b - $fleet_b_mu
  $delta_z_a = if($dz_a_raw > 0, $dz_a_raw, 0.0)
  $delta_z_b = if($dz_b_raw > 0, $dz_b_raw, 0.0)
  $z_a_sq = $z_a * $z_a
  $z_b_sq = $z_b * $z_b
  $dz_a_sq = $delta_z_a * $delta_z_a
  $dz_b_sq = $delta_z_b * $delta_z_b
  $personal_norm_sq = $z_a_sq + $z_b_sq
  $composite_threat_norm_sq = $dz_a_sq + $dz_b_sq

condition:
  $composite_threat_norm_sq >= 0.0

order:
  $composite_threat_norm_sq desc
